第51章 林美丽出嫁-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

林薇张着嘴，啊啊叫着，慢慢地抬起一只脚，往前迈了一小步。

脚落地的瞬间，她的身体猛地往前一栽，林国强眼疾手快，一把接住了她。

“真棒！薇薇会走了！”

林国强把她抱起来，在她脸上亲了一口。

林薇被亲得痒了，咯咯地笑起来，两只小手拍着林国强的脸。

“再走一次好不好？”

林国强把她放回椅子边，退后一步，伸出手。

林薇扶着椅子站好，看了看林国强的手，又看了看自己的脚，犹豫了一下，又迈了一步。

这次比上次稳了一些，但走了两步就歪了，林国强又接住了她。

“爸爸！”林薇忽然喊了一声。

林国强愣住了。

“你……你说啥？”

“爸爸！”

林薇又喊了一声，这次更清楚，奶声奶气的。

但清清楚楚地喊出了“爸爸”两个字。

赵素梅从灶台边探出头来：“薇薇会喊爸爸了？”

“喊了！刚才喊了！”

林国强把林薇举起来，举得高高的。

林薇在半空中蹬着腿，笑得口水都流出来了，“再喊一声，薇薇，再喊一声爸爸！”

“爸爸！”林薇喊得更大声了，两只手伸下来，抓住了林国强的头发。

扯得他龇牙咧嘴，但他一点都不觉得疼。

林静从屋里跑出来，仰着头看林薇在半空中飞，急得直跳：“爸，我也要飞！我也要飞！”

林国强把林薇放下来，又抱起林静，举了一次。

林静比林薇重多了，他把女儿举得高高的，林静在半空中咯咯笑着。

赵素梅站在灶台边，看着这一幕，笑着摇了摇头，转身去舀水。

晚上，两个孩子都睡了。

林国强躺在炕上，翻来覆去地睡不着。

赵素梅把胳膊搭在他胸口上，迷迷糊糊地问：“咋了？睡不着？”

“薇薇会喊爸爸了。”

“知道了，你都说八遍了。”

林国强笑了，在黑夜里睁着眼睛，看着天花板。

上一世，林静和林薇也会喊爸爸。

但他记得，她们喊“爸爸”的时候，声音总是很小，像是怕打扰到他。

Lin Wei opened her mouth and screamed. She slowly raised one foot and took a small step forward.

The moment her feet hit the ground, her body suddenly fell forward, and Lin Guoqiang caught her with quick eyes and hands.

"Awesome! Weiwei will leave!"

Lin Guoqiang picked her up and kissed her on the face.

Lin Wei was tickled by the kiss and giggled, patting Lin Guoqiang's face with her two little hands.

"How about we go again?"

Lin Guoqiang put her back to the chair, took a step back, and stretched out his hand.

Lin Wei stood up holding the chair, looked at Lin Guoqiang's hands, then at her feet, hesitated, and took another step.

This time it was a little more stable than last time, but after taking two steps, it went sideways, and Lin Guoqiang caught her again.

"Dad!" Lin Wei suddenly shouted.

Lin Guoqiang was stunned.

"You...what did you say?"

"Dad!"

Lin Wei shouted again, this time more clearly, with a milky voice.

But he shouted the word "Dad" clearly.

Zhao Sumei poked her head out from the stove: "Is Weiwei able to call daddy?"

"Shouted! I just shouted!"

Lin Guoqiang lifted Lin Wei up high.

Lin Wei kicked her legs in mid-air, laughing so hard that her mouth watered, "Shout again, Weiwei, call daddy again!"

"Dad!" Lin Wei shouted louder, reaching down with both hands and grabbing Lin Guoqiang's hair.

It made him grin, but he didn't feel any pain at all.

Lin Jing ran out of the house, raised her head and saw Lin Wei flying in mid-air, and jumped with excitement: "Dad, I want to fly too! I want to fly too!"

Lin Guoqiang put Lin Wei down, picked up Lin Jing, and lifted her once more.

Lin Jing was much heavier than Lin Wei. He lifted his daughter high, and Lin Jing giggled in mid-air.

Zhao Sumei stood by the stove, watching this scene, shook her head with a smile, and turned to scoop water.

At night, both children fell asleep.

Lin Guoqiang lay on the kang, tossing and turning, unable to sleep.

Zhao Sumei put her arm on his chest and asked drowsily: "What's wrong? Can't sleep?"

"Weiwei can call daddy now."

"I know, you've said it eight times."

Lin Guoqiang smiled, opened his eyes in the dark night, and looked at the ceiling.

In the last life, Lin Jing and Lin Wei would also call daddy.

But he remembered that when they called "Dad", their voices were always very low, as if they were afraid of disturbing him.
